mapper.select: SELECT b.visit_count AS visitCount, b.word_count AS wordCount, b.score AS score, b.rating_count AS ratingCount, b.comment_count AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_read_history WHERE book_id = b.id) AS readCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_bookshelf WHERE book_id = b.id) AS collectCount FROM book_info b WHERE b.id = #{bookId}
